verdict.rationale: SES receipt rules can store inbound mail in S3, publish it to SNS, send it to WorkMail, bounce it, or trigger Lambda, so rule-based inbound processing exists. A community user still had to write a Lambda to parse each message and forward it to an HTTP endpoint, so POSTing to endpoints needs custom glue code. Missing for 10: evidence of matching rules on recipient or address pattern, native forwarding to other email addresses, a direct webhook/HTTP POST action, and independent corroboration of per-rule routing to different endpoints.
